hard_failures.description: Healthy is presented as authorized.
Review-ready is presented as completed.
Private project information appears in the portfolio layer.
Color alone conveys critical state.
Mobile or reduced-motion behavior is missing.
Fictional data is presented as real proof.
Concept directions lack material creative range or traceable generative lineage.
Concepts collapse into one typography, art-direction, composition, page-grammar, or interaction family; omit a complete page journey; or reuse comparison-only runtime evidence.
No concept passes the separate impact review as compelling, or the signature fails to control at least three journey roles.
Generated exploration is promoted as unexplained pixels instead of being dispositioned and extracted into a project-specific system.
A declared page grammar lacks its required behaviors in the bound complete prototype or is visible in fewer than two journey stages.
A deep journey repeats fewer than four structural expressions, or a single-canvas instrument lacks a persistent canvas with four distinct state recompositions.

A concept expands without exact single-source reconstruction, two correction passes, a literal project substitution, controlled divergence, and an independent combined-pixel review; loses an approved mechanic; or replaces source-defining media with primitive decoration.
A selectable concept lacks a complete consultation summary, concrete brand guideline, or passed evidence-consistency record.
Consultation feedback is stale, lacks rationale, omits a required material visual delta, fails to reach explicit readiness, or is treated as selection or approval.
The exact approval bundle omits or changes a selected concept brand-guideline hash.

A benchmark silently reuses an existing design or prior concept set instead of defaulting to fresh concepts, or enters review or refinement without an explicit user instruction and inherited-artifact provenance.
A fresh run has fewer than three complete directions, accepts an incomplete slop stub, or lacks a screenshot-bound quality review by a reviewer other than the producer.
A concept enters consultation below 75 quality, above B AI-slop, with a hard design rejection, or without a clear user outcome, primary action, product proof, and five-second reaction.
An agent marks its own concepts ready for selection, or the consultation surface buries visual comparison beneath specification detail.
A benchmark substitutes producer-authored pass booleans for the native concept validator, raw collision-aware browser probes, or independently attested dimension scores.
The primary carrier is absent from the opening mobile viewport, interaction changes no measurable rendered state, or protected semantics change between states.
